"""validate_rows spine (M1-T03): keep rows with a close, sorted by (date, ticker)."""

from mdata.types import RawRow
from mdata.validate import validate_rows


def test_sample_drops_the_blank_close_and_keeps_the_rest_in_order(contract_sample):
    rows = [RawRow(**r) for r in contract_sample("mdata.RawRow")["rows"]]

    out = validate_rows(rows)

    assert out == [
        RawRow("2024-03-01", "AAPL", 180.0),
        RawRow("2024-03-01", "MSFT", 400.0),
        RawRow("2024-03-04", "AAPL", 182.5),
        RawRow("2024-03-04", "MSFT", 402.0),
        RawRow("2024-03-05", "MSFT", 405.5),
        RawRow("2024-03-06", "AAPL", 176.5),
        RawRow("2024-03-06", "MSFT", 407.0),
    ]


def test_unsorted_rows_come_out_sorted_by_date_then_ticker():
    rows = [
        RawRow("2024-03-04", "MSFT", 402.0),
        RawRow("2024-03-01", "MSFT", 400.0),
        RawRow("2024-03-04", "AAPL", 182.5),
        RawRow("2024-03-01", "AAPL", 180.0),
    ]

    out = validate_rows(rows)

    assert [(r.date, r.ticker) for r in out] == [
        ("2024-03-01", "AAPL"),
        ("2024-03-01", "MSFT"),
        ("2024-03-04", "AAPL"),
        ("2024-03-04", "MSFT"),
    ]


def test_all_blank_closes_give_no_rows():
    assert validate_rows([RawRow("2024-03-01", "AAPL", None)]) == []
